findings.title: forcequitOS/worse_query: A sandbox escape for iOS 26 and 27
findings.summary_md: forcequitOS published worse_query, a proof-of-concept iOS sandbox escape for iOS 26.0 through 26.7.2 and iOS 27.2, on November 8, 2026. The repository requires an App Group container and can reach other apps' data paths. It is the direct successor to the earlier bad_query proof of concept. The README states it is not relevant to a jailbreak.

findings.title: Release Worse Query Files 0.4
findings.summary_md: Christoph Kolbicz released WQ Files 0.4, a no-jailbreak file browser and app data manager built on worse_query, on November 9, 2026. The release was tested on iOS 27.0.1 and requires sideloading with an App Group entitlement. It includes a plist editor and hex viewer for browsing and editing other apps' data.

findings.title: WQFiles Brings a No-Jailbreak File Browser and App Data Manager to iOS 27
findings.summary_md: pbxscience reported that WQ Files was released as a no-jailbreak file browser and app data manager for iOS 27. It is built on worse_query, a sandbox escape technique published one day earlier by forcequitOS. The article notes worse_query was published on November 8, 2026 as a proof of concept.

findings.title: SlowMist: iOS worse_query Vulnerability Is a Sandbox Escape; Beware of Wallets Storing Mnemonic Phrases in Plaintext
findings.summary_md: PANews reported on November 10, 2026 that SlowMist Chief Information Security Officer 23pds warned iOS wallet users on X. The warning described worse_query as a container sandbox escape rather than a jailbreak. It cautioned that wallets storing mnemonic phrases in plaintext could be exposed.

findings.title: SlowMist Flags iOS Sandbox Escape Risk to Wallet Data
findings.summary_md: The Defiant reported that SlowMist warned the public worse_query iOS sandbox-escape proof of concept could expose plaintext wallet secrets. The risk applies if a user runs a malicious app on an affected iPhone. The article was published on November 10, 2026.

findings.title: Binance warns iPhone users of iOS bug that could expose crypto wallet keys
findings.summary_md: crypto.news reported Binance's warning that the worse_query iOS vulnerability could expose crypto wallet keys and recovery phrases. It urged users to remove untrusted apps and update. The article was published on November 10, 2026.
